rf-both.label: Batters with at least 150 balls both for DC and for other teams
rf-both.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
rf-both.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mine, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY pl.name, year, mine

rf-drops.label: Batters who scored more slowly for DC than elsewhere
rf-drops.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
rf-drops.filters: Strike rate relative to the season average (100 = average); min. 150 balls for the franchise and elsewhere
rf-drops.query: SELECT pl.name, CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (8,11) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END mine, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs, SUM(CASE WHEN d.is_wide = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) balls FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY pl.name, year, mine
